L'Épine-de-Mer forme un nodule marin parfois comparé à un coquillage fixé à la roche. Il faut briser sa partie extérieure pour en consommer la chair, qui restaure 1 à 6 points de vie. La substance se conserve plusieurs mois avant de se dessécher, mais son accès dépend des milieux côtiers où elle se développe.

This nodule is found chiefly in cool temperate climates, especially in sea coasts and saltwater shores, and is best known throughout Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains very hard to find.

Seathorn forms a marine nodule sometimes likened to a shell fixed to rock. Its outer layer must be broken open so that the flesh inside can be eaten, restoring 1–6 concussion hits. The substance keeps for several months before drying out, but can only be gathered in the coastal environments where it grows.
